text:
arjun: Heads-up — long-context stress job on dedicated-h100 cluster shows steady KV cache memory growth over ~6h, not reclaimed between generations. Captured pagetable snapshot; looks like duplicate mappings for the same logical slot after pagewalk compaction.

nina: Which cluster/driver combo? any diff vs MI250x tests?

arjun: repro run on h100-prod-2 (470.82 driver), also saw a noisy repro on mi250x-test1 (ROCm 5.7) but pattern differs. H100 retains ~2-3% more resident GPU pages over time.

sam: short guess: could be concurrent kernel selection + batching causing overlapping KV writes so pager's shadowmap coalescer misses merges. Did you see overlapping stream timestamps?

arjun: yes — timelines show overlapping encode kernels from both batching and async prefetch streams. Trace snippet:
```
[1623.123] stream0: kv_write(slot=0x7f3c, page=12345, len=64)
[1623.124] stream1: kv_write(slot=0x7f3c, page=12345, len=64)
[1623.125] pager: mark_pending(page=12345)
[1623.130] compactor: attempt_coalesce(page=12345) -> found 2 in-flight refs, skip_coalesce
```
arjun: compactor skipping causes an extra shadow entry to be kept and eviction logic never hits the expected LRU path.

maya: interesting — on MI250x we saw fragmentation but compactor skipped for different reason: TLB invalidation latency sometimes reordered completions, leaving stale owner refs. Driver differences could explain arch delta.

sam: do we have a small repro command? I want to run with kernel_selection=off and batching=single to compare.

arjun: repro: `tools/longctx_repro --model gpt-4x --seq 64 --ctx 32768 --batching profile:concurrent,window:8 --kv-prefetch async --duration 6h` — to run reduced: set --duration 5m and --ctx 4096 to trigger issue faster.

nina: good. I'll run on mi250x-test1 and h100-prod-2 with `--kernel-fallback=none` and `--kernel-fallback=aggressive` variants. Will attach satelite perf counters.

tracebot: Created perf trace: traces/kv/pagetable-skew/trace-1758001234-01 (size 18MB) :eyes:

perf-bot: Auto-analysis: found 132 instances of duplicate page entries in snapshot; median time between duplicate insert and eviction attempt = 12.4s. Flagging as "possible compactor race".

sam: if hypothesis holds, quick mitigation: serialize compaction for same logical slot using lightweight ticket (per-slot spin) so only one compactor run can skip-coalesce. Not ideal perf-wise but safe.

maya: can we instead make eviction check resilient to duplicates? e.g., when eviction sees >1 shadow entry for same page, prefer oldest owner and decrement duplicate refs rather than bail. That might be more robust across drivers.

arjun: agreed — two parallel paths: (1) short-term: make eviction tolerant to duplicate shadow entries; (2) medium: add per-slot compactor serialization and a metric to count skipped_coalesce events.

nina: I'll open GH issue and a PR template. Assigning to @arjun and @sam to prototype.

arjun: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/4981 — put reproducer, pagetable dump, traces. Labels: eng-runtime, bug, high-priority.

sam: I'll prototype per-slot mutex in the pager and run perf delta. If perf hit >5% we revert to eviction-tolerance patch.

maya: schedule 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to review traces. I'll bring MI250x traces and driver memstats.

nina: thanks, team. quick note: add a flag `--kv-pagewalk-instrument` to increase debug logging for 1 minute windows, that'll help capture timing of the double inserts.

arjun: added flag and toggled on in repro. next steps: run both kernels off/on, collect traces, iterate PRs.

perf-bot: Regression alert watch added on branch kvcache/compactor-fix. Will report perf numbers after CI. :thumbsup:

nina: ping me with traces link when ready, I'll correlate with infra metrics (PCIe stalls, nvlink counters).

sam: nice triage. One more thought — batching heuristics may be producing bursts that align with GC cycles; let's try smoothing window to 4->2 and see if it reduces collisions.

arjun: noted. I'll include smoothing config in the issue. Thanks everyone.
